_about: The campaign's numbers: rewards, timers, the bank, the challenger, achievements and cosmetics. Every value here is checked by tools/check-campaign.py and signed by tools/sign-content.py.

damage._about: What a hit does. Every half heart of damage knocks one of an armor plate's four pieces off (dent, crack, half, gone). crush: breakers, double damage to armor. pierce: goes straight through armor to the hearts.

plots: {npc} has money riding on you. {n} trials across {island}, one after another. Don't embarrass either of us.
The crowd wants a show, and {npc} means to give them one: {n} trials, in order, each with a twist.
Word on {island} is you've gone soft. {npc} wants {n} wins in a row to prove otherwise.
{npc} found an old tourney ledger with your name in it. Finish its {n} trials before the week is out.
A rival challenger is watching. {npc} needs {n} trials walked, start to finish, to save face.

mods.name: Swarm
mods.text: Twice as many hazards and enemies.

mods.name: Glass Scales
mods.text: No hearts, no armor, no canister: one hit ends it.

mods.name: Blackout
mods.text: You can only see around your head.

mods.name: Bare Scales
mods.text: No gear, spells, snacks, familiars or canisters.

mods.name: Champion
mods.text: The challenger's own champion hunts you through the level: a boss you only meet in quests. Beat it for a bounty, or just win the level.

gems.storeSoon: Gem packs arrive when the game launches. Until then gems come from achievements, quests, level challenges and the bank.
gems._store: Build 53: the gem shop (click your gems in the top bar). price is what a real store will charge, in cents; in development every offer is free and only adds to the save. gems: gems added. boosts: levels of each booster (surge = power-ups turn up more often, lucky = more loot; revive counts single uses, switched on before a level). daily: once a day, free.

store.name: Power-up surge
store.text: Power-ups turn up twice as often for your next 5 levels.

store.name: Lucky finds
store.text: Loot drops half again as often for your next 5 levels.

store.name: Second chance
store.text: 3 revives. Switch one on before a level and a deadly blow gets you back up with half your hearts.

store.name: Power-up bundle
store.text: 50 gems, surge and lucky for 10 levels, and 3 revives.

achievements.name: Giant Slayer
achievements.text: Finish a boss's last stand on any island.

achievements.name: Not a Scratch
achievements.text: Win a level without losing a heart.

achievements.name: Untouchable
achievements.text: Win 25 levels without losing a heart.

achievements.name: Worn to the Hilt
achievements.text: Use a piece of gear until it breaks.

achievements.name: Exchange Rate
achievements.text: Make a trade at a bank.

zones._about: Build 51: where every island's levels sit. edge: the rim crumbles into sinkholes. shop: by the merchant, whose ice box leaks popsicles. trap: snares in the grass. mountain: the climb to the last lair, more lightning at every level up.
